messages:
Sam P (Product): FYI — Nimbus wants a private deploy pilot with per-tenant cold-start <120ms p95 and per-request encryption. They asked for a 6-week pilot footprint. Need to align infra/runtime/security.

Imani (CS): Customer expects steady 300 TPS across 200 tenants with occasional tenant-level spikes 5x for ~2min. Model: distilled 7B, avg seq ~512. They care more about tail latency than absolute throughput.

Leo K (Runtime): 7B @512 is easier, but 120ms p95 is tight for cold-start without aggressive prewarm + KV reuse. Need runtime knobs: hot shards, prefix caching, evict policy tuning.

Maya T (Infra): For VPC-private we need route maps, dedicated NAT gateways, and egress policy. Also capacity planning: recommend reserved burst pool, estimate 4 x a2 instances for pilot unless runtime reduces.

Jun H (Security): Per-request encryption = customer-managed keys via our soft-KMS or HSM. HSM timeline ~4 weeks provisioning + compliance signoffs. Soft-KMS plus tenant isolation acceptable for pilot with enhanced audit.

Rita (SRE): Observability asks: tenant-level latency heatmap, eviction metric, and token-cost per-tenant. Need runtime to emit tenant tags. Also want an automated pager if p95 > 130ms for 3 min.

Leo K (Runtime): We can emit tenant tags and token metrics. Work: 9d to implement prefix caching + tenant labels + exposure endpoints. Canary routing + auto-fallback to local quantized variant estimated +3d.

Maya T (Infra): Logging ingestion will increase. With sampling and aggregation we can keep cost small. Infra work: 7d to provision burst pool, 4d to configure networking, 3d for logging pipeline changes.

Sam P (Product): Timeline reality check: customer wants pilot in 6 weeks. Combined estimates look like ~3 weeks runtime + ~3 weeks infra + security tasks in parallel. We can try to hit 6 weeks if we reduce security HSM requirement for pilot.

Jun H (Security): Agree to soft-KMS for pilot if keys are tenant-scoped and rotated per spec. Must run a lightweight code review + config audit before go. That audit takes 4 business days.

Imani (CS): I can get customer signoff on soft-KMS pilot, but they want documented plan to switch to HSM in prod within 90 days.

Rita (SRE): To lower risk swap: start pilot with 50 tenants (canary cohort) and scale to full 200 after 2 weeks of stable metrics. That buys time to tweak caching.

Sam P (Product): Proposal accepted: staged rollout. Phase 0 = 50 tenants, soft-KMS, p95 goal 120ms but SLO for pilot 140ms; Phase 1 = scale to 200 tenants, HSM planned, commit to 120ms in prod within 90 days.

Leo K (Runtime): Action items for runtime: 1) prefix/KV caching prototype (9d), 2) tenant tagging & metrics (2d), 3) canary routing + fallback (3d). I'll break into two PRs: proto + canary.

Maya T (Infra): Infra action items: 1) reserve burst pool (7d), 2) networking/VPC config (4d), 3) logging sampling + aggregation (3d). I'll also draft rollback knobs for model draining and capacity throttles.

Jun H (Security): Security action items: 1) soft-KMS config & tenant isolation (4d), 2) config audit (4 business days), 3) schedule HSM provisioning for post-pilot (submit request this week).

Rita (SRE): SRE action items: dashboards (tenant-level latency, eviction rate), runbooks for eviction storms, and alerting rules. Estimate 5d to deliver dashboards if telemetry ready.

Imani (CS): I'll manage customer comms and confirm spike windows + acceptance criteria. Also will run contract update to reflect phased SLA.

ci-bot: CI pipeline report: runtime branch for tenant-metrics passing unit + integration tests.

Sam P (Product): Risks: 1) eviction storms if we mis-tune cache, 2) increased logging costs, 3) HSM delay. Mitigations: staged rollout, sampling for logs, and commit to HSM timeline in contract.

Leo K (Runtime): Note: if eviction storms occur, immediate mitigations = increase retention for top-N tenants, enable prewarm on high-hit prefixes, and route noisy tenants to dedicated pool.

Maya T (Infra): I'll include autoscale limits and a quick throttle switch in the network plane to shed traffic to backup model endpoints if needed.

Jun H (Security): I'll prioritize config audit and push HSM request; if any high-risk issues found we will block scaling beyond Phase 0.

Rita (SRE): I'll pair with Leo on telemetry schema so dashboards are ready when runtime emits metrics.

Sam P (Product): OK, decision recap (confirming): Pilot scope = 50 tenants canary -> scale to 200 after 2 weeks. Soft-KMS in pilot; HSM targeted post-pilot. Pilot SLO = 140ms, prod goal = 120ms within 90 days. Owners: Leo (runtime), Maya (infra), Jun (security), Rita (SRE), Imani/Sam (customer & PRD).

Imani (CS): I'll send the phased plan to Nimbus and ask for a signed pilot acceptance by EOD Friday.

Sam P (Product): I'll draft PRD + action tracker today and create kickoff meeting. Thanks all :rocket:
